quarterly_data.quarter: HPE press release: HPE accelerates enterprise AI innovation with (10-07-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: HPE announced the first four of its HPE ProLiant Gen13 Servers, powered by 6th Generation AMD EPYC Server processors: the DL585a Gen13 (up to eight double-wide PCIe GPUs, two 6th Gen AMD EPYC processors, PCIe Gen6), the DL525 Gen13 (1U single-socket, one 6th Gen AMD EPYC processor with up to 256 cores, 16-channel DDR5 / MRDIMM memory, PCIe Gen6), and the OCP-compliant XD245 (1OU four-node direct liquid-cooled, up to eight 6th Gen AMD EPYC processors) and XD285 (2OU two-node air-cooled). Availability: DL525 Gen13 later in 2026, DL585a Gen13 in early 2027, XD245 and XD285 in 2027. HPE says ProLiant Gen13 will expand beyond the systems announced today.
quarterly_data.figure: first four ProLiant Gen13 servers; DL525 up to 256 cores, available later in 2026; DL585a up to eight GPUs, available early 2027; XD245 / XD285 available in 2027
quarterly_data.counterparty_role: partner (6th Gen AMD EPYC server CPU platform)
